indicator_name: Output gap by four methods (HP, one-sided HP, Hamilton filter, unobserved components) and potential growth (computed by this repository)
description: Разрыв выпуска четырьмя методами (HP, односторонний HP, фильтр Гамильтона, модель ненаблюдаемых компонент) и рост потенциального ВВП (расчёт репозитория)
unit: % of potential GDP; % a year (potential growth); bn KZT at 2010 prices (GDP)
methodology: Input: QNA_GDP_EXPENDITURE_SA_CONSTANT_2010 item GDP (BNS seasonally adjusted real GDP, 2010 prices, from 2010 Q1), 100 x log. HP lambda 1600 two-sided (end-point bias in the last quarters) and one-sided (real-time); Hamilton (2018) h = 8, p = 4 (gap starts 2012 Q4); UC: local linear trend + AR(2) cycle (statsmodels UnobservedComponents, Kalman smoother; gap = log GDP - smoothed trend). MEAN averages the four where all exist. Revised every quarter as the sample grows; a production-function estimate is not included (no official capital stock series).
